name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
description: Monthly pension for elderly senior citizens living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension of ₹500 to ₹1,000 (enhanced with state contribution)

criteria.description: Applicant must be 60 years or older
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant has not reached senior citizen age (60+)

criteria.description: Applicant household must be Below Poverty Line (BPL)
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant household is not classified as BPL
